set.body: Adversarial review after P7.4 found three verified false guarantees: CanonicalJson prints numerically equal JsonNumber spellings differently; ScriptSource.Inline's source-private enum constructor still emits public JVM constructor/apply/copy/fromProduct methods that bypass the bound; and the local release gate accepts any launcher JDK despite claiming JDK 17. Normalize canonical numbers with laws, enforce the inline bound inside every generated construction path while retaining wire shape, and make the gate reject non-17 launchers.
set.title: Repair post-P7.4 invariant and release-gate escapes
